first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The short-brown-haired Person A who is continuously followed by the camera, wearing a dark blue-gray top and brown trousers, with a brown shoulder strap and a pouch at the side of the waist.

entities.name: shop stall with a red roller shutter
entities.identification: The shop stall on the right side of the passageway, with red exterior walls, light-colored framing strips, and a gray roller shutter with horizontal ridges.

entities.name: wet flagstone passageway
entities.identification: The gray-brown paved stone ground between the stalls on both sides that leads to the blue-and-white steps, with dark wet patches and lighter reflective areas.

entities.name: group of people lying in front of the steps
entities.identification: The existing group consisting of three people lying respectively beside the wooden-slat partition, in front of the blue-and-white steps, and beside the shop stall on the right, excluding Person A.

entities.name: orange-fruit table
entities.identification: The orange wooden table in front of the shop stall on the right, with pineapples and stacked goods on it; the front structure is only partially in frame.

entities.name: blue-and-white steps
entities.identification: The wide, multilevel steps connecting the passageway to the raised market platform, with gray treads and risers faced with small light-blue and white tiles.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: The long gun that Person A lifts beside the fruit table and subsequently holds with both hands, with a dark gun body, yellow-brown components, and a hanging gun sling.

entities.name: wooden-slat partition
entities.identification: The tall partition on the image-left, composed of yellow-brown horizontal wooden slats and vertical framing strips, with gaps between the slats.

entities.name: raised market hall
entities.identification: The market area above the blue-and-white steps, with light-colored square columns, darker counters, and hanging goods.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The silver-gray short handgun held low in Person A's right hand at the start of the clip, with its exposed gun body extending toward the bottom of the image.

entities.name: market container
entities.identification: The collection of containers in the market; the entries in this clip mainly correspond to the blue-green buckets and basins on the ground on the near side of the wooden-slat partition.

entities.name: pineapple
entities.identification: The fruit clustered at the right end of the fruit table, with yellow-green oval bodies and gray-green crowns of pointed leaves.

entities.name: stacked goods
entities.identification: The gray-brown flat stacked objects on the fruit table, with layered edges and light-colored binding lines.
